LessonProgress.title: Lesson Progress
LessonProgress.description: Tracks a learner's completed English lesson stored in Cloud Firestore to power the real-time motivational Progress Bar.

userId.description: Authenticated Google user UID owning this lesson completion record.

levelCode.description: CEFR level code of the completed lesson.

titleAr.description: Arabic title of the completed lesson for display and history.

completedAt.description: Server timestamp (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()) when the lesson was first marked complete.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()) of the most recent update.

DailyWord.title: Daily Word
DailyWord.description: Stores the user's Word of the Day ('كلمة اليوم') card, pronunciation listen counter, and practice completion status in Cloud Firestore.

userId.description: Authenticated Google user UID owning this daily word entry.

ipa.description: IPA phonetic transcription of the word.

meaningAr.description: Concise Arabic translation of the word.

exampleEn.description: English example sentence using the Word of the Day.

exampleAr.description: Arabic translation of the example sentence.

levelCode.description: CEFR level code of the word.

practiced.description: Whether the learner marked today's word as practiced/mastered.

listenCount.description: Number of times the user listened to the pronunciation.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()) when the daily word entry was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()) of the latest engagement.

QuizQuestion.title: Lesson Quiz Question
QuizQuestion.description: Stores post-lesson quick quiz questions in Cloud Firestore.

userId.description: Authenticated Google user UID owning this quiz question record.

lessonId.description: ID of the lesson this question belongs to.

orderIndex.description: Display order within the lesson quiz.

englishPrompt.description: English sentence or prompt for the question.

options.description: Bounded list of multiple-choice answer options (2 to 6).

correctIndex.description: Zero-based index of the correct option.

explanationAr.description: Arabic explanation shown immediately after answering.

levelCode.description: CEFR level code of the question.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()) of the last update.

QuizResult.title: Lesson Quiz Result
QuizResult.description: Stores a learner's post-lesson quick quiz evaluation result, best score, and attempt count in Cloud Firestore.

userId.description: Authenticated Google user UID owning this quiz result.

levelCode.description: CEFR level code of the lesson.

correctCount.description: Number of correct answers in the latest attempt.

totalCount.description: Total number of questions in the quiz.

scorePercent.description: Percentage score (0-100) of the latest attempt.

bestScorePercent.description: Highest percentage score (0-100) achieved across attempts.

attemptCount.description: Total number of completed quiz attempts for this lesson.

passed.description: Whether the learner achieved the passing threshold (>= 60%).

/users/{userId}/lessonProgress/{lessonId.description: User-scoped subcollection storing completed lesson records keyed by lessonId.

/users/{userId}/dailyWords/{dateKey}.description: User-scoped subcollection storing Word of the Day ('كلمة اليوم') cards and engagement stats keyed by yyyy-MM-dd.

/users/{userId}/quizQuestions/{questionI.description: User-scoped subcollection storing post-lesson quiz questions queried by lessonId.

/users/{userId}/quizResults/{lessonId}.description: User-scoped subcollection storing instant post-lesson quiz evaluation results keyed by lessonId.
